import pathlib, textwrap
prog='''def transform(grid):
    missing = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    if not missing:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in missing)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in missing)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in missing)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in missing)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(prog)
ns={}; exec(compile(prog,str(p),'exec'),ns)
